links.outcome: Top-1 diagnostic accuracy of critical care-specific LLM versus general-purpose LLMs on same EICU data
links.effect: Final-stage top-1: Qiyuan 64.1% (118/184), GPT-5.1 59.2%, DeepSeek V3.1 57.1%, Qwen3-32B 51.6%; no significant gaps between Qiyuan and top 2 general models.
links.quote: Corrected pairwise comparisons (α=.0083) confirmed Qiyuan 3.0.1, GPT-5.1, and DeepSeek all outperformed Qwen3-32B significantly (all adjusted P<.008), while no statistical gaps were detected between Qiyuan 3.0.1 and the 2 top-performing general models.

links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of LLMs on real EICU clinical cases
links.effect: All models' top-1 accuracy stayed below 70%, with heterogeneous performance across core EICU diseases including sepsis, severe pneumonia, and gastrointestinal bleeding.
links.quote: Notably, all models' top-1 accuracy stayed below 70%, and stratified analysis revealed heterogeneous performance across core EICU diseases including sepsis, severe pneumonia, and gastrointestinal bleeding.

screen.reason: Retrospective comparative benchmark of domain-specific versus general-purpose LLMs on clinical records from 184 EICU patients to test diagnostic accuracy. Does not test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
